" + "Return ONLY valid JSON, no markdown, no code fences, in exactly this shape:
" + "{"clientName": string or null, "earliestDateIso": "YYYY-MM-DD" or null, "preferredTimeOfDay": "morning" | "afternoon" | "evening" | "any", "notes": string}

" + "Rules:
" + "- clientName: the name of the client to book with. Prefer the name as it appears in the owner's message; fall back to the client name guess only if the message itself doesn't name anyone.
" + "- earliestDateIso: resolve any relative date ('next Tuesday', 'this week', 'tomorrow', 'ASAP') into an actual YYYY-MM-DD date using today's date above as the reference point. 'ASAP'/'as soon as possible' should resolve to today's date. If no timeframe is given at all, use null.
" + "- preferredTimeOfDay: 'morning' (before 12pm), 'afternoon' (12pm-5pm), 'evening' (after 5pm), or 'any' if unspecified.
" + "- notes: a short clean rewrite of anything else relevant from the message (special requests, context, urgency) - empty string if nothing extra." }}
